title: Woningbehoefte onderzoek Drechtsteden 1974
authors: Vries, J.H. de, Rongen, M.J.T., Blonk, G., Bouwcentrum * Rotterdam (primary investigator)
descriptions: Opinion about condition own house / motivations to move from there / location / characteristics of house sought ( regarding rent ) / distance of major public utilities / opinions about present street and neighbourhood / use of and opinions about public transport and private car ( especially parking near house ) / the environment / social climate / contacts with neighbours / privacy. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ consumption of durables
